verdict.rationale: Adyen documents platform-side transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations that don't meet business requirements, so enforcement can happen without your own code. The evidence never says these rules support amount caps over daily, monthly or all-time windows, transaction-count velocity limits, or per-card versus per-cardholder scoping. Per-card balances are only an adjacent funding control. Missing for 10: documented amount caps over daily/monthly/all-time windows, transaction-count velocity rules, per-card and per-cardholder (account holder) rule scoping, ops/UI configuration of limits, independent corroboration.
